prompts.cast-01:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: reusable character sprite sheet for adult Easy-Read legal explanations.
Input images: Image 1 is ONLY inspiration for the simple rounded, flat-color cartoon drawing style. Image 2 is ONLY the required four-pose layout and waist-up framing. Create an ORIGINAL character; do not reproduce either image.
Primary request: One fictional adult character repeated in FOUR consistent waist-up poses, in one landscape horizontal row. Exactly four equal-width columns, generous empty transparent gutters and outer margins. The same character and outfit in every column; heads and hands fully inside their own quarter; equal scale and waist baseline.
Style: Simple friendly animation illustration with broad solid-color shapes, minimal facial detail and flat skin color. Match the visual simplicity of Image 1, not the detailed rendering of Image 2. Respectful adult presentation.
Subject: an adult man with short side-parted dark hair, teal overshirt over a cream shirt and navy trousers. The lower face is one smooth uniform skin-color shape.
Poses left to right: listening with hands relaxed; explaining with one open palm extended; politely refusing with one raised open palm; considering with eyes lowered toward empty open hands.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha, no drawn checkerboard, scenery or ground shadow.
Constraints: Exactly the same one character in all four poses. No text, labels, symbols, logos, watermarks, props or other people. Landscape aspect about 2:1.
